title: AGe-PD: Influence of Age and Genetic Status on the Progression and Treatment Response of Parkinson’s Disease

interventions.name: Parkinson’s patients with deep brain stimulation (DBS) and a young age at onset (<45 years) are followed over time to detect deviations from patients with typical age of onset and to identify different disease trajectories within the group depending on underlying genetic mutations (control groups us
Parkinson’s patients without deep brain stimulation (DBS) and with a young age at onset (<45 years)
Parkinson’s patients with and without deep brain stimulation (DBS) and with a late age at onset (>45 years)

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Parkinson's disease
Exclusion criteria:
age <18 years
